author: NingMeng123
scope: 024 furnace tiers, heat, all reference fuels, batch recipes, automation and modern processing adaptation

source_state_machine.max_heat_enforcement: SlotFuel.a and asg.b(1,stack) validate fuel before normal insertion; canSmelt itself does not check max heat
ordered_steps: server: if burn_remaining != 1 and front flooded/face-solid, set burn_remaining=0 and cook_progress=0, unlight, return; heat is untouched by this early return
capture was_burning; if burn_remaining>0 decrement once, otherwise set heat=0
server: if burn_remaining==0 and canSmelt(potential_fuel_heat), set duration=remaining=item.getBurnTime and on positive duration store fuel heat, consume1 fuel, retain item.t container when empty
if burning and canSmelt(current heat), increment progress; at exactly200 set0 and smelt; otherwise set progress0
on burning-state change switch source idle/active block preserving tile entity and metadata; mark changed
source_state_machine.no_recipe_or_output_room: Do not light a fresh fuel; already burning fuel continues being consumed but progress resets
source_state_machine.fuel_swap: Active fire retains consumed fuel heat until remaining burn expires; replacement slot fuel only affects the next ignition
source_state_machine.front_flooding: Source getNeighborBlockMaterial == water. Modern waterlogging is a separate fluid-aware adaptation.
source_state_machine.smothering: The facing neighbor opposite face uses block.isFaceFlatAndSolid, not top cover or rainfall
source_state_machine.front_menu_access: aok.onBlockActivated -> abw.isAirOrPassableBlock(include_liquid=true) -> neighbor must not be solid. Water can still be opened through while it extinguishes combustion.
source_state_machine.one_tick_exception: Exactly1 remaining tick skips front extinguish check; decrement0 may ignite the next fuel and cook1 even when front is blocked. Subsequent tick extinguishes.

sand.query_heat_minus_1: Returns registered sandstone result for recipe discovery without applying batch count or heat.

clay_block.clay_oven_rejection: Full block input is large; use hardened-clay or sandstone oven, not the small clay oven.

source_batches.metal_ores: 1 ore -> 1 ingot, required heat copper/silver/gold/iron2, mithril3, adamantium4

source_fuel.heat_units: discrete level0..4; no Celsius source value exists
source_fuel.tool_xj: effective material wood ->200, any wood constituent ->100, otherwise0. All qualities/damage consume one entire tool for the same burn time.
source_fuel.filled_bowl: 0, including foods and water/milk; original override checks isEmpty()
source_fuel.wood_blocks: ItemBlock first checks canBurnAsFuelSource; log1600, planks/double-slab/wood-button400, slab/sapling/dead-bush200, torch/redstone-torch/ladder800, other wood-material400. Wood signs use their carried item override200, not the uncarried block400.

source_large_items.important: Raw clayballs, buckets and charcoal are small. Logs, planks, slabs, coalblocks and ores are large. Clay furnace rejects both large input and large fuel.

source_environment_and_persistence.bottom_extract_fuel: Only empty bucket class wr when removing fuel slot1 from bottom; output always allowed
source_environment_and_persistence.break_inventory: aok preserves inventory on lit-state transition, spills all3 slots only when actually removed; quality/damage/NBT preserved

source_experience.manual_output: Output item reward per item times quantity actually taken; original recipe XP table is not used.
source_experience.hopper_output: Successful transfer of one item from furnace immediately spawns item reward orb in front of furnace; no food exclusion.
source_experience.no_duplicate_payout: The modern version must not also accumulate vanilla recipe XP for these source rewards.

source_skills.ported_default: No skill gating is enabled solely because the helper methods exist.

source_lava_bucket_filling.trigger: Only collecting lava, not furnace consumption or pouring
source_lava_bucket_filling.loss: Convert one empty bucket to null when melted. All metals except adamantium are harmed by lava.
source_lava_bucket_filling.ordinary_fill_source_removal: Original survival nonctrl collects without removing fluid; Ctrl or creative removes fluid.
source_lava_bucket_filling.place_source: Ctrl with at least100 total XP permits source and consumes100XP; otherwise water/lava placement schedules removal after16/48ticks.
source_lava_bucket_filling.modern_exception: 024 preserves modern source pickup and placement interactions; old Ctrl/fluid scheduling is a separate future material-container feature.

modern_adaptation.smoker: Retains smoking recipe category and100tick cycles; heatcap1 prevents metal stage bypass.
modern_adaptation.blast_furnace: Retains blasting recipe category and100tick cycles; heatcap2 rejects lava/blaze and mithril/adamantium smelting.
modern_adaptation.modern_fast_fuel_cost: The same source fuel burn duration is used for100tick cycle machines; faster throughput is an explicit modern adaptation.

checks: cookTick every slot before progress or final production
campfire.invalid_injected_input: Keep original stack and progress unchanged, do not craft or drop a result; process all other valid slots normally.

modern_adaptation.raw_metals: Explicit same2heat as copper/iron/gold ore, including modern raw-metal blocks if a recipe exists.
modern_adaptation.deep_ores: Same source-metal or gem heat as stone-substrate counterparts.
modern_adaptation.red_sand_and_sandstone: Same four-input sand batching, sandstone direct glass rule as normal variants.

modern_adaptation.source_shape_inheritance: Other modern logs1600/planks/buttons/doors/stairs/fences/trapdoors400/slabs/saplings200/boats1200 atheat1; nonflammable Nether wood stays0. Explicit adaptations are not claimed as old source registrations.
modern_adaptation.unknown_mod_fuel: Use registered native burn time at heat1 unless explicitly mapped; may not reach high-temperature stages.
modern_adaptation.wet_sponge: Modern empty bucket exception is permitted in fuel slot only for wet sponge, including metal peers; returns matching water bucket after drying.
modern_adaptation.server_enforcement: GUI, shift-click, hopper, NeoForge item capability and tick revalidate fuel heat/large/cap; injected overheat fuel is rejected, unlike original canSmelt direct-call gap.
modern_adaptation.full_output_safety: Original canSmelt checks count<max, then adds4 for redstone/lapis and can exceed stack size. Modern atomic capacity check refuses batch if fewer than4 output spaces are free. This original bug is deliberately not reproduced.
modern_adaptation.persistence: Modern integer burn/progress plus separately versioned persisted heat preserves active fuel across save/load; no short truncation.
modern_adaptation.retained_vanilla_arrow: Original item262 is not registered. Retained modern arrow corresponds to R196 flint-tip arrow1040; all9 original ItemArrow variants have100ticks atheat1.

acceptance_cases: Six source profiles and all positive/zero mapped fuel match original bytecode
Small clay furnace accepts charcoal/sticks/paper but refuses logs/coalblock/ores
Coal in small oven is rejected without consumption; copper requirescoal2; mithril requireslava3; adamantium requiresblaze4
Sand1/3 does not ignite; sand4 woodheat1->sandstone, coalheat2->glass
Sandstone coalheat2->glass1; clayballs1/3/4/5 bulkcorrect and full output safe
Active heat follows consumed fuel, not currently changedslot; no insufficient-heat freshfuel consumed
Furnace front water and full solid extinguish, flower/torch/roof/rain behavior differs correctly
All sided inventory/capability routes reject invalidfuel; emptylava bucket preserved and extractedbottom
Source food and ore XP manual/hopper do not doublecount across save/reload
Native smoker/blast/campfire preserve their cooking types and do not bypassheat4
Block removal preserves all inventory components; explosions give source materialloot
Client sees sourceheat/max/min and burntime from synced server data
